headline: Nzovu warns RDA
summary: Infrastructure Minister Collins Nzovu directed the Road Development Agency to immediately dismantle its Axle-Load Management section on the Copperbelt. He alleged collusion with transporters to overload trucks, which he said damages road infrastructure.
why: Axle-load enforcement protects road networks from damage caused by overloaded freight trucks, which affects transport costs and the logistics that mining and trade depend on in the Copperbelt.
